# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 108 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 52 | Coptic

---

## Saying 108

**1** Jesus said: "Whoever drinks from my mouth will become like me. I myself shall become that person, and the hidden things will be revealed to him."

---

**Translator's Notes (EMET):**

- "Drinks from my mouth" — the mouth as source of the living water/teaching; a Johannine echo (John 7:37-38)
- "Become like me" — *homoios* — transformation into the image of Jesus
- "I myself shall become that person" — the reciprocal transformation: Jesus also becomes the disciple
- "The hidden things will be revealed to him" — *apokrupha* disclosed; the mysteries made manifest
- The mutual transformation is unique: not just the disciple becoming like Jesus, but Jesus becoming the disciple
- This is the Thomas version of mystical union (*henosis*)
